dataset: Korean Elementary Learning Map math subject workstream
subject: Mathematics
sourceBasis: Official NCIC 2022 revised mathematics curriculum PDF [별책8] was downloaded from the public NCIC inventory and parsed with pdftotext. Elementary achievement-standard codes, grade bands, domains, and local topic headings were checked against that extraction. Standard source bodies are not embedded.

textPolicy.summaryPolicy: Topic and standard summaries are source-derived paraphrases and decomposition labels; full official achievement-standard sentences are not reproduced.
textPolicy.licenseCaution: CLEARED: the cited Korean curriculum documents are state-published public materials openly available from their original sources (Ministry of Education, National Education Commission, NCIC). Preserve attribution and consult PROVENANCE.md.

sources.name: 교육부 고시 제2022-33호 [별책8] 수학과 교육과정.pdf
sources.usage: Governing source for elementary mathematics domain structure and achievement-standard code inventory.

notes: The previous v0.3 scaffold had 72 generic math anchors; this subject artifact replaces that with 121 official elementary math achievement-standard codes from the 2022 PDF.
Each official standard is decomposed into three candidate micro-topics: concept, representation, and application/assessment.
Dependency suggestions are intentionally candidates for the integration card, not reviewed prerequisite facts.
Human-facing math summaries, topic labels, and assessment prompts use code/module anchored paraphrases to avoid placeholder Korean particles and official-text re-publication.
